title: Clank! Legacy: Acquisitions Incorporated
subtitle: A deck-building adventure of corporate thievery
tagline: Establish your franchise, steal the loot, don't get eaten.
loreSummary: You are a lowly employee of the famous adventuring company, Acquisitions Incorporated. Build your deck, delve into the dungeon, and try to escape with your life (and the company's artifacts). Every choice shapes your world, permanently.
keyFeatures: Permanent changes to cards, rules, and the game board
Humorous narrative set in the Acquisitions Incorporated universe
Push-your-luck dungeon delving with dragon attacks

clank_standard.name: Standard Franchise Campaign (10 Sessions)
clank_standard.description: The standard corporate contract. Most franchises complete their core objectives in 10 working days.

clank_extended.name: Extended Audit (12 Sessions)
clank_extended.description: For overachieving franchises that take the scenic route to middle management.

milestones.title: Corporate Orientation
milestones.description: Establish your franchise, hire your first employees, and sign the convoluted contracts.

milestones.title: Middle Management
milestones.description: Expand your territory, face rival franchises, and discover the upper management's true plans.

milestones.title: Executive Review
milestones.description: Face the ultimate corporate challenge and secure your franchise's legacy forever.
